# Onebright

> > Onebright is a UK-based online therapy and neurodevelopmental assessment provider offering CBT, EMDR, and diagnostic services for ADHD and autism across adults, children, and corporate clients.

Onebright specializes in private psychological therapy and neurodevelopmental assessments delivered online throughout the UK. The platform serves individuals, families, and employers with evidence-based treatments including Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), trauma-focused interventions, and specialist ADHD/autism evaluations.

## Key Topics

- CBT (Cognitive Behavioural Therapy)
- ADHD assessment
- Autism assessment
- EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing)
- Trauma-focused therapy
- Online therapy
- Neurodevelopmental assessment
- Mental health services
- Adult diagnosis
- Child mental health
- Workplace wellbeing
- PTSD treatment
- Anxiety and depression
- Employee mental health
- Private medical insurance
